title: Finding Validation Layer — Zero False Positive Foundation
goal: Add an automated validation step for each finding that confirms exploitability against the live target before the finding is reported — matching XBOW's 'validator' approach that enables their zero-false-positive guarantee.
scope: Implement: (1) A validation_status lifecycle extension on findings: unvalidated → validation_queued → validation_running → validated_confirmed → validated_not_reproduced → validation_skipped. (2) A FindingValidator service in api/app/services/finding_validator.py that, for a confirmed finding, generates a minimal targeted re-probe: selects the appropriate runner and a minimal param set derived from the finding's evidence (tool, target, stdout_excerpt pattern), creates a validation task linked to the finding via source_finding_id, runs it through the normal task dispatch path, and compares the result against the original finding evidence. (3) Validation runs are always passive or active tier — never intrusive — and use a narrowly scoped re-probe, not a full rescan. (4) Findings with validation_status=validated_confirmed display a green 'Verified ✓' badge. Findings with validated_not_reproduced display an amber 'Unconfirmed' badge and a note explaining the re-probe result. (5) The validator is opt-in (AUTO_VALIDATE_FINDINGS=false by default). (6) Validation results are additive — they never delete or modify the original finding.
generation_reason: XBOW's automated validators confirm each vulnerability before reporting, enabling a zero-false-positive guarantee. AegisPT currently marks findings as 'operator-validated' only after human review. An automated validation layer reduces false positives, increases finding credibility, and enables a 'confirmed findings only' reporting tier that matches enterprise buyer expectations.

constraints.scope_creep_guard: Validation probes are passive or active tier only — never intrusive. Validation never modifies, deletes, or escalates the original finding. Disabled by default. Validation tasks follow the same scope enforcement as all other tasks.
